meta.purpose: Modeled cognitive functions. Functions are NETWORK_PROCESS values. They must not map one-to-one onto regions.
meta.rule: Never compile FUNCTION from a single REGION.
meta.educational_source: Rita Carter et al., The Brain Book (DK, 2019) — Brain Functions; Language; Memory; Thinking; Attention and Consciousness; Movement and Control
meta.disclaimer: These entries are educational models for a fictional language. They do not claim to locate consciousness, talent, or moral worth.

functions.notes: The Brain Book: apparently rational decisions are driven by emotional circuits as well as prefrontal evaluation. Not frontal_lobe.
Encoding, storage, and retrieval recruit hippocampus plus widespread cortex. Not a REGION assignment.
The Brain Book treats attention as tightly coupled with conscious report, not as a parietal coordinate.
Frontal, temporal, and parietal areas plus arcuate_fasciculus. Usually left-lateralized in adults, still a NETWORK.
The Brain Book discusses creativity as a high-level thinking topic. It is not a frontal_lobe identity and cannot be assigned from a random coordinate.
Planning, basal ganglia selection, cerebellar coordination, corticospinal output.
The Brain Book: limbic structures produce emotions as responses beyond simple approach/avoid. Distributed, not amygdala = feeling.
Retina → thalamus → visual cortex → dorsal/ventral streams. Expectation from frontal networks feeds back into seeing.
The Brain Book: the social brain and mirror-neuron discussions are network-level, not a license to compile personality.
Thalamic relay plus specialized cortices. Infant looking behaviour is an observation, not this function itself.

processes.notes: Laying down a memory (The Brain Book). Dynamic activity, not an ID.
Developmental white-matter change. FA can rise as fibres align and myelin matures — a PROCESS, not a destiny.
Typical developmental reduction of synapses. Temporary biology, not character.

signals.notes: Stand-in for fMRI BOLD. A simulated activity pattern, not a thought.
Stand-in for an oscillatory pattern. SIGNAL ≠ consciousness.
